original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: Determine the exact minimum paid rank-one calls for three repeated I3 targets in the 338-frame alphabet A=u v^T/2 (nonzero ternary 3-vectors), allowing arbitrary finite restored dirty registers, repetitions and all call orders.
scope_change_reason: Enlarge the scalar register count beyond the three-register predecessor, while restricting rational frames to an explicit half-integral finite alphabet and fixing all three targets. The initial four-register search reduces to conditions independent of register count.
bottleneck_link: An eight-call construction would have optimistic moment (8/9)*3^a before extra charges for three width-three outputs. The nine-call obstruction rejects this concrete catalytic route; it does not restrict other frame alphabets or the selected supplier.
stop_rule: Complete exact determinant/coefficient census through eight calls, independently check its finite premises and parity witnesses, exhibit a nine-call formal word, and stop without enlarging the alphabet.
evidence: README.md proves the reduction; CERTIFICATE.json records the exact census and six additive-character witnesses; verify.py and independent.py replay the finite claims without importing each other. Final validation details are in the PR.
author: Tuafo
ai_assistance: Prepared for Tuafo with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance: GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning for candidate derivation, independent proof review, independent implementation and review; root integration. Separate AI checks do not constitute independent human review.

open_questions.first_step: Specify the larger frame set and derive determinant and target-coefficient necessary conditions before any scalar-projector search; measure the candidate count and look for separating additive characters.
open_questions.blocked_by: The present finite census and parity certificates cover only A=u v^T/2 with ternary vectors; no larger-alphabet search or physical implementation is supplied.

open_questions.question: Can the determinant/coefficient/character elimination be made symbolic for an unbounded dyadic alphabet?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A symbolic result could avoid repeated bounded searches and clarify which arithmetic hypothesis must change.
open_questions.first_step: Classify why the six surviving multisets admit an integer-valued parity functional and find a candidate outside that separable class.
open_questions.blocked_by: No general separation theorem is proved here; absence of a parity witness would not establish a circuit.
